Transcript charts · rail strip

Real app CSS and transcript markup; live Vega-Lite. Hover a line for values, hover a series label to isolate its line.

view

Rules

  • Every chart is a rail row of its own, open by default like tool images. Folded, it shows a sparkline and, for one series, the latest value; that value is not repeated in the open chart.
  • Up to three lines are ink: #000 solid, #555 dashed, #777 dotted. Four to six lines take blue orange violet aqua magenta brown, in series order, validated against #fff for colour-blind and normal-vision separation across all pairs. chart() rejects more than six series; the script folds or splits. Red is reserved for breached thresholds.
  • Series are named at their line ends; crowded labels spread to 13px in value order with hairline leaders. At phone width a one-line key replaces them. Hovering a label or key entry isolates that series.
  • The hover tooltip lists every series at that time, highest value first, each with its line key.
  • Chart text is JetBrains Mono 11px in --g3; data marks are the only heavy ink (2px lines, 1px everything else). Square bar ends, no radius, no shadows.
